0022600199.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 13th in the East) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West) for their 10th game of the season, with Brooklyn on a one-game losing streak and 1-4 on the road, while Dallas has won its last game and is 3-2 at home. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Grant Nelson, who is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Nets lost all three meetings with Dallas in 2025-26, most recently a 123-114 defeat in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
